newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Ice stretches across Gulf of Bothnia.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Ice stretches across Gulf of Bothnia.

text.p: New ice stretched over the middle of the Gulf of Bothnia and ice thickened further outside the coasts above 57 degrees north, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Thursday.

In its twice-weekly report, the institute specified new restrictions to navigation in the Gulf of Bothnia, allowing only ice class IA with minimum deadweight of 2,000 tonnes to Raahe and classes IA and IB with minimum deadweights of 2,000 tonnes to Kokkola, Pietarsaari and Vaasa from January 3.
Four icebreakers were on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, three in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia and two in the middle of the Gulf of Bothnia, it said.
